events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched in the United States on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto screens, forever changing the music landscape. And the first video? The ironically titled 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles. We're still here though, aren't we?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on August 29, 1994, marking a significant moment in Britpop history.

angles.name: Britpop Debut
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and introduced us to a new era of British rock. Still sounds as fresh and defiant as ever.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in counterculture history.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the fields of Bethel, New York, began to fill for Woodstock. Three days that defined a generation with peace, love, and unforgettable music.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and charisma remain unmatched.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire generations, even decades after his passing.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable images in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman continues to rock with inimitable style.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Biblical Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that iconic swagger and unmistakable voice to the world. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1975, following its album release in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that resonates as strongly today as ever.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced its first iPod portable music player on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: Music In Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember when the iPod changed everything? Twenty-five years ago, Apple put a thousand songs in our pocket and truly revolutionised how we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas, launching the world's most famous secret agent. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary musician and activist, John Lennon. His impact on music and culture is truly immeasurable.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' eclectic 'White Album' first landed. A sprawling masterpiece that showcased every facet of their genius.
